people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
translations.bsb: Just then the angel of the LORD called out to him from heaven, “Abraham, Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.
